nodes.label: EZ FOOD Logo (favicon vite.svg)
nodes.description: 48x48 square brand mark: white background, large gray (#737373) 'EZ' letters with an underline bar, and small dark (#3f3d47) letters 'F','O','O','D' stacked vertically on the right, reading 'EZ FOOD'. Includes an embedded masked PNG layer. Served from public/ as the app favicon, replacing the default Vite logo while keeping the vite.svg filename.
nodes.rationale: Keeps the default Vite filename so index.html's favicon link keeps working without changes, while showing the nutrition app's own branding.
